manual: Recording runs gpu-screen-recorder: Omaxian's Flatpak (flatpak install flathub com.dec05eba.gpu_screen_recorder) through omarchy-gpu-screen-recorder, or a gpu-screen-recorder on PATH.
The Flatpak cannot write to /tmp: keep the output folder (default ~/Videos/omareel) under your home.
Clicks and keys need membership in the input group (sudo adduser $USER input, then log out and back in). Without it recordings have the pointer path but no click effects or keystrokes.
Rust comes from rustup (install.sh installs it and the toolchain in rust-toolchain.toml). Debian's rustc 1.85 is older than the crates need.
On X11 nothing keeps the recording bar and camera bubble out of the capture: with one monitor they stay hidden while recording; stop with omareel record (bind it to a key) or omareel record --stop.
